messages.subject: sqldf on data frame when RPostgreSQL is loaded
messages.subject_clean: sqldf on data frame when RPostgreSQL is loaded
messages.body_plain:
Hello everybody,

I would like to know how to use sqldf on dataframes when RPostgreSQL is loaded. I tried several options for the drv parameter but it always want to use postgres.
Is it possible to load RPostgreSQL and sqldf simultaneously and makes sqldf do operation on dataframes ?

Thanks in advance for your help,

François Valenduc
